title: HERA: a web server for host element reference-based aligner.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context: supplement holds only 4 figure images (jpg/gif, 0.19 MB total); no GEO/SRA/Zenodo/Dryad records; the only text-mined 'accessions' are two DOIs of other papers. A HEAD request to the HERA web server returned 200 (HTML page, 10,850 bytes).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The paper describes a plasmid comparison and visualisation tool built on BLAST (a sequence-alignment program) with annotations from existing tools and PLSDB (a public plasmid database). The data availability statement names only the web server; no dataset is deposited.

a1_downloadable.note: No dataset exists: this is a software/web-server paper. The supplement is 4 figure images; the data availability statement points only to the interactive server.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table and no label. Any target would have to be built from scratch using other resources such as PLSDB.

a3_inputs_present.note: No input sequences were released with the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: No label exists. Annotations HERA produces (replicon typing, resistance genes) are outputs of other tools, so they would be circular as labels.

honest_claim_h3: None: the paper releases a visualisation tool, not data, so no model claim can be made from it.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use plasmid DNA sequences to predict plasmid traits such as host range or mobility.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need plasmid sequences from an outside database; this paper supplies none (0 examples verified).
plain_idea.predict: A plasmid property; the paper measures nothing, and its annotations come from other software tools, not lab measurements.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Plasmid-trait prediction matters for tracking antibiotic resistance spread, but this paper adds no data toward it; PLSDB itself would be the real candidate.

label_elsewhere.why: Reject: no dataset in this paper.

ml_idea: None from this paper. A plasmid ML project should start from PLSDB (public plasmid database) directly, evaluated as its own candidate.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already killed: the supplement contains only figure images and no repository deposit exists.

verdict_reason: Web-server software paper with no deposited dataset or labels (A1, A2 fail); supplement is only figure images.
